title: PROOVRA Admin, Platform-Admin & Enterprise closure — remediation ledger
evidenceSources: audit/admin-enterprise-completion-3 @ 73f70508: audit-output/current/admin-enterprise-product-audit.json (30 unique findings, 8 owner decisions, 554-action mutation register)

safety commits 4472f762 and 2bc0b995 (audit/admin-enterprise-completion-2), transplanted as 0a378ca4 and 75b2e95e; def17ede (artifact regeneration) deliberately NOT transplanted — artifacts are regenerated last

ownerDecisions.decision: A — /admin is PROOVRA platform administration only; the 11 workspace-scoped pages move to tenant destinations with tested redirects. No cross-tenant selector.
Explicit read capabilities identity.sso.read and identity.audit.read, deliberately assigned; a generic VIEWER label is not the authority; secrets never projected.
Hide Organization Admin navigation for personal workspaces; a direct URL shows a truthful bounded entitlement state.
Resolve stays offered where operator-resolvable; the backend projects resolutionAuthority/resolvableByOperator/refusalCode/runbookDestination and each refusal code has its own copy.
Verified TOTP satisfies step-up; SMS/WhatsApp remain supported alternatives.
ORG_SECURITY_ADMIN gets verified-domain read and write (mutation behind step-up, confirmation, audit); ORG_AUDITOR read-only; members none; platform admin does not cross tenants.

the providers console merged into /security-center/sso as its Connections section (shared refresh key with the SAML section); page gated on its own security_center.sso entry; redirect from /admin/identity/providers precedes the wildcard

per-purpose factor policy (STEP_UP_PURPOSE_FACTOR_POLICY, total); the server prefers a verified authenticator app and falls back to the verified phone; `channel` names a factor KIND the account holds; start returns method + mask; a TOTP challenge binds factor+generation with no provider attempt and is checked against that factor's secret; guessing bounded at one attempt per challenge and 5 denials per 15 min per factor (429); the enrolment denial names the accepted factors and /settings#security; the modal lets the server choose, switches factor, never claims a code was sent, and offers Start again after a rejected code
POST /v1/identity/mfa/enroll/start is strict; kind SMS/WHATSAPP is a 400 MFA_ENROLL_WRONG_ROUTE naming the contact-factor route; nothing is enrolled

GET /v1/identity/mfa-admin/recovery-requests/:teamId authorizes through authorizeMfaAdminScope (concealed 404 envelope) instead of the posture detour's bare-string 403; the page gates on security_center.mfa_recovery and renders a refusal, never an empty queue

checkOrgAccess reports no ACTIVE membership as not_found (identical to a missing org); orgAccessDenial is the one rendering (404 not_found / 403 forbidden) across organizations, governance, reports, bulk-invite, enterprise-security and domains; owner/admin_required stay member-only after concealment

discoveredDuringRemediation.finding: CONFIRMED (was 'to verify'): trust-and-governance.routes.ts resolveWorkspace returned User.currentWorkspaceId — the caller's own navigation pointer — as the tenant with no membership, status or lifecycle check, for all 51 trust-center, status, department, delegated-admin, policy and access-review routes. A member removed from a workspace, or any user whose pointer named it, read its access-review campaigns through every route without a tier guard of its own
discoveredDuringRemediation.fix: resolveWorkspace revalidates the pointer through the canonical evaluateCurrentWorkspace -> evaluateAuthorizedWorkspace (existence, explicit ACTIVE membership, access expiry, Organization lifecycle, support-access guard) at governance.policy.read, which every member role holds and EXTERNAL_CONTRIBUTOR does not; any refusal answers exactly as a missing pointer always did
